name: giant-head-collage
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:
· MEDIUM: a surreal photo-manipulation caricature — a photograph digitally warped so an enormously oversized head sits on a tiny shrunken body, with glossy commercial retouching.
· GROUND: a pure-white seamless cut-out background, no scenery, the figure floating in empty space.
· TREATMENT: heavy warp and scale distortion, exaggerated bulging features, a seamless composite of the blown-up head onto the miniature body.
· LIGHT: bright even high-key studio lighting, soft shadows, crisp and saturated.
· PALETTE: natural skin pinks and reds against pure white, with small hits of dark-green wardrobe.
· CROP: the full figure isolated and centred with generous white space around it.
· TEXTURE: smooth glossy high-resolution retouch, slightly airbrushed.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
